column1: # W49 NEO scoring-form and query-construction necessity, 8B.
# WHY. Eq. eq:qd states the ordering rule as log a_j + log d_j^2 and
# Eq. eq:likelihood builds the query matrix as [normalized mean; instruction
# token rows] scored by amax. Both read as derivations, but the alternatives
# were only ever screened on 2B at 100/500 steps (see the docstring of
# geopact_qd_selector._bam_select_order). No 8B full-set measurement exists, so
# "why is the log coefficient 1 and not 2" currently has no answer.
# ARMS.
#   base      adopted: log a + log d^2, query = [mean; tokens], amax pooling
#   sharpa    GEOPACT_BAM_SHARP_A=1     -> DPP-square score 2 log a + log d^2
#   lse       GEOPACT_BAM_QUERY_LSE=1   -> log-mean-exp instead of amax
#   meanonly  TURN_QUERY_TOKENS=0, MEANROW=0 -> pure mean-pooled query
#   tokonly   TURN_QUERY_TOKENS=1, MEANROW=0 -> token rows only, no mean anchor
# CAUTION. The v3_nap branch exports these with ${VAR:-default} (preserve-if-
# set), so passing 0 through EXTRA_ENV works. The v3_bam branch exports them
# unconditionally and would silently override the arm (the round-4 blanket-unset
# bug), so every row here must use v3_nap.
# ANCHOR. ScreenSpot-v2 r=10%, copied from w19b_p18304.tsv
# (logs/xds8b_tune/screenspot_v2/covdose50_r10, 73.90). base re-measures it in
# this queue so deltas read against a twin, not a legacy number.
# BENCHMARK|TASK|TRACK|EXP_ARM|RATIO|HIST_N|OUT|LIMIT|EXTRA_ENV
